market_summary: Across all five symbols during late NEW_YORK_SESSION, major pairs and assets are consolidating after earlier directional moves. XAUUSD, EURUSD, and GBPUSD remain depressed below daily VWAP and EMA50 baselines but are stalling near session lows with contracting volume and fading momentum. US100 and BTCUSD remain structurally bullish above VWAP/EMA50, but are currently consolidating mid-range or retesting resistance without strong RVOL/CVD volume expansion. All assets are currently evaluated as HOLD due to lack of immediate breakout/rejection signals.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4014.48) and POC (4044.01). CVD is -3.11 (BEARISH), agreeing with strong downside trend pressure. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (4030.98) and EMA50 (4012.92). It is testing the lower ATR band (3984.57) near Session Low (3982.41). However, price is severely stretched near lower ATR with recent RVOL drying up (last RVOL 1.076), risking a sharp mean-reversion bounce back inside the channel.
signals.level_event: rejection at lower ATR and Session Low

signals.rationale: Price is inside VA (VAL 1.10824..VAH 1.11437) and below POC (1.1092). CVD is -14993 (BEARISH), agreeing with seller bias, though cvd_slope is slightly positive. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (1.11226) and EMA50 (1.11093), currently consolidating between EMA20 and lower ATR (1.10859) just above Session Low (1.10824). Low RVOL (0.697) indicates low expansion volume, favoring continuation of sideways chop within VA.

Price is inside VA (VAL 1.32661..VAH 1.33233) and below POC (1.32813). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1938), showing lack of strong directional orderflow aggression. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is trading below VWAP (1.33055) and EMA50 (1.32931). Price is hovering near mid-channel baseline EMA20 (1.32791) without RVOL confirmation (0.385 RVOL). Rejection of lower ATR line has led to flat consolidation.

Price is inside VA (VAL 28056.98..VAH 28478.48) and above POC (28267.73). CVD is +10.20 (BULLISH), aligning with bullish structure. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well above VWAP (28230.31) and slightly above EMA50 (28344.05). After rejecting near Session High (28596.5), price pulled back inside the ATR channel. Dukascopy tick volume note applies (no yellow spikes needed). However, price is mid-channel between EMA20 and EMA50 without immediate trigger.
signals.level_event: rejection from upper ATR / pull-back toward EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (74030.46) and above POC (73660.42). CVD is BEARISH (-0.06), showing divergence against price breakout. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is holding firmly above VWAP (73842.02) and EMA50 (74072.16). Price is pressing against upper ATR (74792.81) and testing Session High (74706.2). Lack of RVOL spike confirmation and CVD divergence makes buying directly into Session High resistance risky.
